Jamie: quick brain-dump: been thinking about a "lattice" approach for slab placement to reduce long noisy-tenant streaks. idea = micro-shards that overlap so no single tenant stays 'hot' on the same physical slice for too long
Sanjay: short explanation please — how does this differ from dedicated or fractional slices?
Jamie: current dedicated carveouts give long contiguous occupancy which amplifies egress bursts + kv cache thrash. lattice = allocate several overlapping micro-shards per slot and rotate ownership more frequently. soft-affinity, not strict carveout
Leo: wonky. how does this affect warm-pool prefill and KV cache warming? will we just burn tokens and increase cost? :thinking:
Jamie: we'll pay some extra prefill churn. hypothesis: small steady prefill cost << infrequent high P99 spikes and OOM cascades. goal is smoothing, not free lunch
Anya: can you sketch how the selector/config looks so PM and finance can see knobs?
Jamie: yup, prototype flag (example)
```
slot_selector:
  mode: lattice
  overlap: 3           # overlapping micro-shards per slot
  max_contiguous_ownership_secs: 300
  prefill_headroom_pct: 2.5
  eligibility_score_threshold: 0.3
```
Sanjay: metrics to collect: tenant_p99, slot_rotation_rate, kvcache_hit_rate, egress_queue_depth, prefill_tokens_per_minute, and a new one: consecutive_ownership_secs
Leo: + track warm_pool_restart_rate and prefill_retry_count. fail-safe: if prefill_retry_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> disable lattice on that rack
Jamie: canary plan I'm thinking:
- canary: 2 racks in eu-west-1, only unpinned/non-critical tenants
- duration: 48h with synthetic spike test + 24h steady state
- rollback: if any pinned tenant sees >12% tenant_p99 regression OR if prefill cost delta > +25% for canary cohort
Anya: sales/finance will worry about pricing. can we scope to low-tier noisy tenants first, or only apply to tenants with positive noise score so we don't raise net cost?
Sanjay: agree. we should compute an eligibility score and target only allocations with score <= 0.3 (i.e., noisy/short-lived). keeps exposed cost neutral
Leo: I'll spin up racks and wire the ff. who writes the scoring fn? I can do pseudo but need the normalizer funcs
Jamie: quick scoring fn idea (pseudo):
- score = 0.6 * norm(egress_rate) + 0.3 * norm(kv_miss_rate) + 0.1 * (is_long_running ? 1 : 0)
- normalize to 0..1 using historical 95th percentiles
Ops-bot: [deploy-bot] feature-flag created: ff/slab-lattice-probe.eu-west-1
Anya: please also include a billing delta dashboard per-tenant label so we can show finance the cost impact. need daily and hourly breakdowns + top-10 tenants by delta
Jamie: noted. also adding a small runbook and rollback CLI snippet
```
# disable lattice on rack
curl -X POST https://ops.api/flags/ff/slab-lattice-probe/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
Leo: assigned to provision infra and wire alerts. will post urls once available
Sanjay: assigned: Jamie (scheduler hook + scoring impl), Leo (canary infra + alerts), Anya (billing dashboard + finance deck). start window: tomorrow 09:00 UTC. ping me when flags live
Ops-bot: [alert-bot] alert rule created: slab-lattice.prefill-retry-rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page oncall
Anya: also request: export metrics with tenant_label and billing_tag in every series so finance can pivot by customer
Jamie: agreed. plan to publish 2h, 8h, 24h telemetry snapshots and a short summary. starting canary tomorrow. :rocket:
